# Mimic

![Mimic](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/mimic.png)

Heads: does what the Heads side of a random other coin in your deck does.

- **Rarity:** Epic
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Nothing

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
